snippet.title: Chain of Command | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Chain of Command!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4439360/Chain_of_Command/

Join the Discord for updates: https://discord.gg/de5QkCNV

Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the demon armies.
